hooks.name: Backend runs in Docker
hooks.description: Reminds the agent that the Hudaayah backend (Django + PostgreSQL) runs via Docker Compose, with the canonical dev commands, so it never falls back to a host venv or bare runserver.

action.prompt:
Backend runtime for this project is Docker (Docker Compose v2), NOT a host virtualenv.

When scaffolding, running, migrating, or testing the Django backend:
- Start the stack with `docker compose up --build` (services: `web` = Django/DRF on port 8000, `db` = postgres:16). API is at http://localhost:8000/api/v1/.
- Run management commands inside the container, e.g. `docker compose exec web python manage.py migrate` / `createsuperuser` / `test`. Do NOT instruct the user to create or activate a host venv or run bare `python manage.py runserver`.
- Inside Compose the database host is the service name `db`, not `localhost`.
- Secrets come from a gitignored `.env` injected via Compose `env_file`; never bake secrets into the image or commit them.
- Postgres data lives in a named volume (`pgdata`); warn before any destructive DB/volume operation.

See .kiro/steering/tech.md ("Docker / local runtime") and .kiro/specs/al-fatihah-mvp/design.md (§9 Runtime / deployment) for details.
